smart_match.description: Use source evidence when it supports a claim; use generated mood imagery only for non-evidence ambience, covers, dividers, or conceptual support.
smart_match.source_evidence: Preserve source figures, tables, screenshots, logos, and quoted source snippets with source/source_id metadata.
smart_match.generated_mood: Allowed for hero/background/concept imagery when it does not imply factual evidence.

source_only.description: Use only images and tables extracted from attached sources. Do not generate new factual or decorative imagery unless the user later asks.
source_only.source_evidence: All visual claims must be backed by ingested source assets.
source_only.generated_mood: Disabled except for simple editable shapes, backgrounds, and typography.

no_images.description: Do not add image blocks. Use editable text, tables, shapes, metrics, and layout rhythm instead.
no_images.source_evidence: Use source text/table data where needed, but avoid image placement.
